_about: JSON Schema for TopologyIR — passed as the `input_schema` of a strict tool_use definition so the LLM literally cannot emit tokens that violate it. Eliminates JSON-parse failures (the dominant retry trigger today). Mirrors the dataclass in envil_agent/intent/ir.py field-for-field; keep them in sync — `TopologyIR.from_dict()` consumes whatever passes this schema. Lives in JSON (not Python) so a project extending the IR adds fields here without forking the LLM-call code.
_strict_rules: Anthropic strict mode constraints (2026): no minLength/minimum/maximum, no recursive refs, max 24 optional params per object, max 16 union-typed params. Keep this schema flat-ish.
tool_description: Emit the TopologyIR JSON describing the requested circuit. ALWAYS use this tool — do not reply with text. Pin references in net.pins follow `<ref>.<pin>` where `<pin>` is a pin NAME (preferred for ICs from the pin_catalog) or a pin NUMBER (resistors, caps, diodes — use 1/2). Pick lib_ids that exist in the user's library; the pin_catalog block lists exact pin names for the common parts.

circuit_type.description: Top-level circuit class. Pick the closest match; engine uses this for layout heuristics.

components.description: Every part on the schematic. ref must be unique.

ref.description: Reference designator: R1, R2, C1, U1, Q1, D1, J1, Y1, SW1, FB1, etc.

lib_id.description: Exact KiCad library:part name (e.g. 'Device:R', 'Timer:NE555', 'MCU_ST_STM32G0:STM32G030F6Px'). Never invent — pick from the pin_catalog when possible.

value.description: Display value: '10k', '100n', 'NE555', 'AMS1117-3.3'. Use IEC 60062 form (no decimal point on resistors: 4k7 not 4.7k).

footprint.description: Optional footprint library reference. Leave empty string for engine to fill from defaults.

nets.description: Every named electrical net. Power rails (VCC, GND, +5V, +3V3) must have is_power=true.

name.description: Net name. Canonical power rails: GND, +3V3, +5V, +12V, VBUS, VBAT. Signal nets: descriptive (UART_TX, RESET, MISO, CAN_H).

pins.description: Pin references in <ref>.<pin> form. Use pin names from the pin_catalog for ICs (e.g. 'U1.VCC'); pin numbers for passives ('R1.1', 'C2.2').

is_power.description: True for power/ground rails — gets a PWR_FLAG so ERC sees the net as driven. False for signal nets.

blocks.description: Optional functional grouping. Emit [] for single-IC circuits (NE555, LM317, single op-amp). Emit a list ONLY when 2+ distinct multi-pin ICs/connectors exist AND each block contains its own ≥3-pin anchor.

name.description: Short UPPERCASE block name: POWER, MCU, USB, RESET, CLOCK, PROTECTION, ICSP, SENSOR, MOTOR, AUDIO_IN, DEBUG, MEMORY.

component_refs.description: Refs belonging to this block. Every ref in components[] must appear in exactly one block when blocks[] is non-empty.

flow_role.description: Optional left-to-right ordering hint. 'source' = power input (USB-C, battery). 'regulator' = LDO/buck/boost. 'compute' = MCU/DSP. 'sink' = output peripherals. Leave empty for engine default.

anchor_pins.description: Optional list of pin refs (e.g. ['U2.VDD']) that attract decoupling caps from other blocks. Leave [] for engine default.

buses.description: Optional bus declarations (rule R9). Emit when 4+ nets share a `<prefix><digit>` pattern (e.g. DATA0..DATA7) and you want the engine to render them as one bus line `DATA[0..7]` with bus entries instead of 8 separate labels. Leave [] for the engine's automatic per-net labels.

name.description: Bus label: either the bare prefix ('DATA') or the explicit range form ('DATA[0..7]'). Engine canonicalises to the range form on render.

members.description: Net names belonging to the bus. Each must be declared separately in nets[].

width.description: Optional convenience; equals len(members). Architect can omit.

notes.description: Optional 1-2 sentence design rationale. Helps debug. Keep under 200 chars.
